(02) What we supply

Materials for every critical stage.

From hillside gabion retention and concrete reinforcement to roof steelwork and building services, explore our seven core supply families.

View full catalogue & specs
01 / 07Gabion & wire

Gabion mesh

Heavy-duty woven and welded gabion baskets and mattresses for retaining walls, slope stabilisation and erosion control.
02 / 07Gabion & wire

Steel wire products

Galvanised chain-link fencing, barbed wire, binding wire and heavy-duty coils for site fixing, fencing and fabrication.
03 / 07Steel & reinforcement

Reinforcement materials

Ribbed high-yield deformed steel bars (rebar) and welded BRC mesh for structural concrete foundations, columns and slabs.
04 / 07Steel & reinforcement

Structural steel

I-beams, H-beams, square and rectangular hollow sections (SHS/RHS), angle iron, channels and galvanised steel pipes.
05 / 07Building services

Plumbing materials

PPR, uPVC, HDPE and GI pipes, pressure fittings, valves and drainage supplies for building and civil water systems.
06 / 07Building services

Electrical supplies

Power cables, conduits, distribution boards, circuit protection and earthing hardware for building and site installations.
07 / 07Construction essentials

General construction materials

Waterproofing admixtures (including Sika solutions), fasteners, formwork hardware and essential site supplies.

(03) The Fortimesh advantage

Focused on the materials behind lasting work.

We supply quality steel products, gabion mesh, fencing wire and essential building materials for residential, commercial and civil infrastructure projects across Rwanda—combining responsive pricing with dependable site logistics.

  1. 01

    Complete project consolidation

    Source gabions, wire, rebar, structural steel, plumbing, electrical and Sika waterproofing solutions through a single Kigali supplier.

  2. 02

    Quotes matched to your specification

    We verify bar diameters, section wall thicknesses, wire gauges, zinc/PVC coatings and quantities directly against your BoQ or drawings.

  3. 03

    Yard collection or nationwide delivery

    Collect directly from KG 667 Street in Kimironko, Kigali, or coordinate phased truck deliveries to your project site anywhere in Rwanda.

About our company

(04) Where materials work

Built around real site needs.

01 / 04

01 — Civil & hillside engineering

Hold the ground.

Rwanda’s terraced hills and road corridors demand durable slope protection. We supply heavy galvanised and PVC-coated gabion baskets, mattresses, lacing wire and perimeter chain-link fencing built to withstand heavy rainfall and earth pressure.

Gabion mesh Steel wire products

02 — Reinforced concrete & steel frames

Build the frame.

From D8–D32 deformed rebar and BRC mesh in the foundation to I-beams, hollow sections and galvanised pipes in the roof structure, we deliver structural steel against your engineer’s bar schedule and cutting list.

Reinforcement materials Structural steel

03 — Mechanical & electrical services

Make it work.

Complete your building envelope with PPR/uPVC/HDPE pipework, valves, power cables, conduits and distribution switchgear—sourced directly from your mechanical and electrical bills of quantities.

Plumbing materials Electrical supplies

04 — Waterproofing & site essentials

Keep the site supplied.

Combine your primary steel delivery with Sika waterproofing chemicals, tie wire, nails, welding consumables and formwork hardware to reduce transport trips and keep crews productive.

General construction materials

(05) How ordering works

From schedule to site delivery.

A clear specification is the fastest route to an accurate quotation. Three straightforward steps get materials moving to your site.

Start your request
  1. Step 01

    Send your schedule

    Share your bill of quantities, bar bending schedule, drawings or itemised material list via our quote tool or WhatsApp.

  2. Step 02

    Receive itemised pricing

    Our Kimironko sales desk verifies stock availability, technical grades and unit pricing for your exact specification.

  3. Step 03

    Coordinate site delivery

    Collect from our Kigali stockyard on KG 667 Street or schedule direct dispatch to your project site anywhere in Rwanda.
